requestedIntent: Add a genuinely minimal lane for reversible contained work so ordinary UI, copy, config, docs, mechanical changes, and localized bug fixes do not pay the lightweight six-step lifecycle cost.
limitations: Direct closeout records focused verification command and exit code but intentionally does not create evidence manifests or runner proof.
Path and risk inference is heuristic; unusual domain risk that is absent from paths and omitted from riskTriggers cannot be discovered mechanically.
Direct is limited to one attended, reversible technical boundary and must promote when scope, surface count, risk, or test-integrity checks expand.
This capability is enforced by schema/parser/validator and installer tests but has not yet been empirically proven on target-repository delivery runs.
